_comment: The knowledge-file contract, in the form src/factory/errorkb.py validates against.
SCHEMA.md beside this file is authoritative for the prose rules and the reasoning;
this file is deliberately a small declarative subset, not JSON Schema, because the
repo is stdlib-only and a ~80-line validator can read this directly.
Field spec keys:
type      str | int | bool | list | obj  (a trailing '?' means null is allowed)
required  true when the KEY must be present. A required key whose type ends in
'?' must still be present -- explicitly null, never omitted.
enum      the complete set of permitted values
pattern   a Python re fullmatch applied to a string value
min       minimum length for a list or a stripped string
of        the spec each list element is checked against
unique    for a list of objects, the field that must be unique within the file
Files whose name starts with '_' are not data and are never loaded.
The code in the filename must equal the `code` field. A caseForm file must have
code: null and must name that case in appliesTo.cases.
codeForm is the BASE code -- any -S<x>Q<y> suffix is stripped, the same key
32x-error-code's base_and_flags() resolves to.

stations._comment: station keys as registered in src/factory/stations.py

_comment: The entire basis of the Post-CA verdict. null is permitted and
honest -- it yields verdict 'not-evaluable'. Omitting the key is an
error, because an absent key cannot be told from a forgotten one.
Empty string when kind is fleet. A dut value is a SERIAL and is always
a JSON string -- several serials carry leading zeros and a numeric read
silently drops them (see src/shopfloor/yamlout.py).
What a human actually wrote at the source. Quote or paraphrase; never
infer. A field not stated at the source is omitted, not guessed.
NOT a field in any knowledge file. Recorded here so the contract is in one place.
Computed in src/factory/postca.py from appliedAt against the occurrence stream,
scoped by the action's scope. Rates, not counts: raw counts fall whenever the line
slows down, which would score every fix as effective during a quiet week.
